description: Panel from a polyptych, Umbria, c. 1450. St John, a beardless young man in a red mantle, stands on rocky ground and holds an open book. A gold background closes the scene.
definition: St John the Evangelist standing, holding a book

variantes.description: Panneau de polyptyque, Ombrie, vers 1450. Saint Jean, jeune homme imberbe au manteau rouge, se tient debout sur un sol rocheux et tient un livre ouvert. Un fond d'or ferme la scène.
Panel from a polyptych, Umbria, c. 1450. Standing on rocky ground against a gold background, the beardless young St John, wrapped in a red mantle, holds an open book.
Panel from a polyptych, Umbria, c. 1450. St John, a beardless young man in a red mantle, stands on rocky ground and holds an open book. An eagle stands at his feet.
Panel from a polyptych, Umbria, c. 1450. St John the Evangelist, a beardless young man in a red mantle, stands on rocky ground and holds an open book.
Panel from a polyptych, Umbria, c. 1450. St John, a beardless young man in a red mantle, stands on rocky ground and holds an open book, while a small donor kneels at his feet.
Panel from a polyptych, Umbria, c. 1450. The young St John who stands on rocky ground, holding an open book, is not John the Evangelist: he is the Baptist as a youth.
